notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Attention Players,

From everyone at DYMENSION we wish you a wonderful holiday season and a Happy New Year with your family, friends and loved ones as we celebrate the end of another year!

This year has been a busy, fruitful and beautiful one for the entire creative team of Hashiriya Drifter. We are excited about what lies ahead in the coming year and look forward to sharing our future plans with you.

In the meantime, you still have the opportunity to buy our game at a reduced price and enjoy playing and sharing this novelty with your friends.

Thank you again for your support and happy holidays from the Midnight Games Team!

Over and out, 

Midnight Games

notes.title: NOMINATE US
notes.notes:
Nominate DYMENSION:SCARY HORROR SURVIVAL SHOOTER for the category below as suggested by the developers of this game.
It’s a horror first-person game where you have to plunge into a complicated story that at first glance seems simple, but hides a lot of details and puzzles, you're alone in the dark only to survive this night.
